command: set -e; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK" ANDROID_HOME="$SDK"; export PATH="$SDK/platform-tools:$SDK/emulator:$PATH"; android --sdk="$SDK" emulator start medium_phone; adb wait-for-device; test "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d '\r')" = "1"; printf 'ANDROID_RELEASE=%s API=%s ABI=%s\n' "$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" "$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')" "$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r')"
